title: J. J. Johnson
summary: He met J. J. at the Three Deuces and says his playing was only execution, not jazz.

story.theme_name: Playing with Coltrane and the avant-garde

blocks.x: What did you think of Jazz Johnson?
I never did know what to think of him. I can't understand nothing but a whole lot of notes.
When did you first meet Jay Jay?
We were playing in the Red Allen band. We were playing at the Three Deuces and he had three pieces there during intermission.
I was kidding with him. He stayed mad with me all the time but I was kidding with him, you know.
He was a heck of a musician, but I can't understand - he didn't play jazz music, not in my opinion, nothing but ... execution, that's the only thing I could hear.
